scripts.build: npm run build -w @ancv/shared && npm run build -w @ancv/backend && npm run build -w @ancv/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ancv/shared && npm run lint -w @ancv/backend && npm run lint -w @ancv/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ancv/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ancv/backend && npm run typecheck -w @ancv/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ancv/shared && npm run test -w @ancv/backend && npm run test -w @ancv/web
scripts.verify: npm run build -w @ancv/shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
